title.zh: 让一次模拟，留下可复查的依据。
title.en: A simulation should leave a trail you can inspect.

summary.zh: 面向早期设计筛选的 Mac 工作台，把几何、假设、求解结果和审阅材料放进同一个项目。
summary.en: A Mac workbench for early design screening, bringing geometry, assumptions, simulation results, and review material into one project.

contribution.zh: 我发起这个项目，把机械工程问题与原生软件开发连接起来。工作覆盖 Swift 与 Metal 界面、Rust 求解流程，以及输入和结果的追溯。
contribution.en: I founded Anvil to connect mechanical engineering with native software. The work spans Swift and Metal interfaces, Rust simulation workflows, and traceable inputs and results.

decision.zh: 让设置、结果和限制一起被看见。AI 可以协助准备和审阅，工程判断仍需要人来作出。
decision.en: Keep the setup, results, and limitations visible together. AI can assist preparation and review; an engineer still makes the decision.

boundary.zh: 部分路径有限定范围的数值验证，部分仍是回放或探索。尚无物理实验关联或工程认证。
boundary.en: Some paths have numerical checks within a defined scope; others remain replay or exploratory workflows. Physical validation and engineering certification are not established.

alt.zh: Anvil Sim 开发预览，展示结构、热与流体模拟流程及各自的限制说明
alt.en: Anvil Sim development preview showing structural, thermal, and fluid workflows with their limitations

caption.zh: 开发预览 · 早期设计筛选流程
caption.en: Development preview · early design screening workflows

sourceNote.zh: 依据项目说明、验证范围文档与保留的开发预览。这里不把演示等同于客户交付。
sourceNote.en: Based on project documentation, stated verification scope, and the retained development preview. A demonstration does not establish customer delivery.

eyebrow.zh: 感知 × 控制 × 硬件

title.zh: 从摄像头里的世界，到车轮的动作。
title.en: From a camera frame to a moving wheel.

summary.zh: 在小型自动驾驶车上连接视觉感知、嵌入式计算、车道跟随与转向控制。
summary.en: Connecting visual perception, embedded computing, lane following, and steering on a small autonomous vehicle.

contribution.zh: 我的工作包括在 Jetson Nano 上运行车道跟随，以及用 ROS2、YOLOv5 和 OpenCV 构建物体检测流程，把视觉结果接到真实硬件。
contribution.en: My work included lane following on a Jetson Nano and an object-detection pipeline with ROS2, YOLOv5, and OpenCV, connecting vision to real hardware.

decision.zh: 把感知和控制放在同一台车上，面对摄像头、计算与执行之间的实际约束。
decision.en: Bring perception and control onto the same vehicle, where the camera, computation, and actuators must work together.

boundary.zh: 这是小型实验车辆项目，不代表公共道路自动驾驶能力。
boundary.en: This was a small experimental vehicle, not a demonstration of public-road autonomy.

alt.zh: 真实项目小车，车架上装有摄像头、计算板、连线和控制硬件
alt.en: The project vehicle with a camera, compute board, wiring, and control hardware mounted on its chassis

caption.zh: 项目实物 · 摄像头、计算与控制
caption.en: Project hardware · sensing, computation, and control

sourceNote.zh: 依据本人先前公开的项目描述与实物照片；未保留足够测试依据的准确率数字不在此引用。
sourceNote.en: Based on my earlier public project account and hardware photograph. Accuracy figures without sufficient retained test evidence are omitted.

eyebrow.zh: 生活记录 × 产品设计

title.zh: 把值得记住的日子，慢慢种成一座花园。
title.en: Let the days worth remembering grow into a garden.

summary.zh: 一个 iPhone 产品实验：把日记、习惯、日历和专注记录，连到一座逐渐成长的花园。
summary.en: An iPhone product experiment connecting a journal, habits, calendar, and focus sessions to a garden that grows over time.

contribution.zh: 我在探索生活记录的另一种界面：既能回看具体日子，也能感受长期积累。
contribution.en: I’m exploring a different interface for keeping a life record: one that lets you revisit a particular day and see what accumulates over time.

decision.zh: 让时间线保留细节，让花园呈现积累，把记录变成愿意回来看的东西。
decision.en: Use the timeline for detail and the garden for accumulation, making a record you want to return to.

boundary.zh: 仍是开发原型。展示使用虚构记录，不代表已经公开发布的产品。
boundary.en: Still a development prototype. The preview uses fictional records and does not represent a public release.

alt.zh: Life Garden 开发界面，包含日记记录、专注时间和一座小花园，使用虚构演示数据
alt.en: Life Garden development screen with memories, focus time, and a small garden, using fictional demonstration data

caption.zh: 开发版界面 · 虚构示例记录

sourceNote.zh: 依据保留的开发截图与项目介绍；截图中的记录均为示例。
sourceNote.en: Based on the retained development screen and project description. All records shown are examples.

eyebrow.zh: AI 开发 × 工作连续性

title.zh: 让下一次开发，接得上这一次。
title.en: Make the next work session build on this one.

summary.zh: 围绕项目状态、Git 工作保护和验证交付的一层轻量支持，让 AI 辅助开发更容易继续、检查和回退。
summary.en: A lightweight support layer around project state, Git protections, and verified delivery, making AI-assisted work easier to continue, inspect, and roll back.

contribution.zh: 我用它探索长期 AI 协作：把任务留下的状态、实际代码和验证结果连接起来。
contribution.en: I use it to explore sustained work with AI, connecting the state a task leaves behind with its code and verification results.

decision.zh: 将更重的编排缩减为项目真正需要的连续性、工作保护和相关测试。
decision.en: Reduce heavier orchestration to the continuity, work protection, and relevant checks a project actually needs.

boundary.zh: 这是内部工作工具；尚未证明它能提高模型准确率，或适用于所有团队。
boundary.en: This is an internal tool. Improved model accuracy or suitability for every team has not been established.

sourceNote.zh: 依据现行项目说明和轻量化设计记录；没有把历史测试次数作为效果指标。
sourceNote.en: Based on the current project description and simplification record. Historical test counts are not treated as measures of effectiveness.

eyebrow.zh: 世界贸易 × 物品制造
eyebrow.en: Global trade × how things are made

title.zh: 一张贸易地图后面，是怎样的物质世界？
title.en: What is the material world behind a trade map?

summary.zh: 从国家间的贸易关系，走进矿物、材料、工艺和设备，理解一件物品如何来到我们面前。
summary.en: Follow trade relationships into minerals, materials, processes, and equipment to understand how things reach us.

contribution.zh: 我把公开数据与制造知识组织成原生 iOS 探索体验，让地图、具体商品和生产过程彼此连通。
contribution.en: I’m bringing public data and manufacturing knowledge into a native iOS experience, connecting maps, specific goods, and production processes.

decision.zh: 每个观察保留来源和时间；地图上的关系可以继续追到材料与工艺。
decision.en: Keep each observation’s source and date visible, and let a relationship on the map lead into materials and processes.

boundary.zh: 覆盖范围仍有限；贸易关系不是实际航运路线，也不代表实时数据。
boundary.en: Coverage remains partial. Trade relationships are not physical shipping routes and do not imply live data.

alt.zh: Pulse 铁矿石贸易地图，展示澳大利亚、巴西与中国等国家的贸易关系，数据为 CEPII BACI 2024 年
alt.en: Pulse iron-ore trade map showing relationships among countries including Australia, Brazil, and China, using CEPII BACI 2024 data

caption.zh: 实际应用截图 · CEPII BACI，2024 年

sourceNote.zh: 依据项目说明与保留的原生应用截图；不声称已在 App Store 公开发布。
sourceNote.en: Based on project documentation and the retained native app screen. Public App Store availability is not claimed.
